method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: THE COVER AND FORM A CONTRADICT EACH OTHER, and this is the filer's own doing. Form A (p2) carries exactly one inked row - 10-26-10, 'Mark Daines (Self)', $2943 with superscript 41 = 2943.41 - annotated by the filer at the head of the name column 'N A for Others' (i.e. not applicable for anyone else). Cover line 1 (contributions over $50) nevertheless reads a SLASHED ZERO in both the LAST and the CUMULATIVE column (THIS left blank), and line 2 likewise. So the filer itemised his own self-funding on Form A but reported zero contributions on the cover, evidently treating self-funding as not a contribution: he carried the same 2943.41 onto line 3 (expenses) and line 4 (balance) instead. Rows published verbatim, needs_review on the row, nothing adjusted. Cover line 1 is the ONLY anchor - the Carr form prints no schedule total. Scope cannot be decided from the page because neither printed contribution cell matches the rows, so scope is unknown (the row is dated inside the reporting period and the amount equals the cycle-to-date expense figure).

expenditures.detail: Six Form B rows sum to EXACTLY 2943.41, which the cover prints identically in all three of line 3's columns (LAST = THIS = CUMULATIVE, so the two scopes coincide - recorded as cumulative per the addendum). All four cover-line-3 cells are written in the superscript-cents convention (2943 with a raised 41 over a rule) = 2943.41. THE ARITHMETIC DECIDED ONE GLYPH: row 1's cents read as '83' on the 200 dpi full page, which sums to 2943.42 and breaks the cover by a cent; the 1200 dpi column crop shows a flat-based 2, and 47.82 closes the schedule to the cover EXACTLY. Glyph re-read and arithmetic agree on 47.82; the cover's own figure is what settles it.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr form prints no schedule or page subtotal. p3 rows 47.82+425.53+100.00+2100.00+144.06+126.00 = 2943.41 = cover line 3 (all three columns) - EXACT. p2 row 2943.41 vs cover line 1 = 0 - WOULD NOT GATE (see contributions detail); both figures retained.
gates.row_count: Counted by eye against ink on the 200 dpi full pages (Carr sheet, ~40 ruled bands, filers write ON the rule). p3: 6 consecutive inked bands at the top, all others blank -> 6 rows. p2: 1 inked band (plus the filer's 'N A for Others' annotation written above it in the name column, which is not a transaction and was not emitted as a row) -> 1 row.
gates.geometry_proof: p3: the 1200 dpi amount-column strip (y 1150-3100) renders rows 1-6's own amounts in printed order; the control crop one row-pitch below row 6 renders EMPTY. p2: the first-row crop renders '$2943 41'; the control one pitch below renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE as printed: cover contributions 0 (line 1) + 0 (line 2) - expenses 2943.41 = -2943.41, but line 4 balance reads 2943.41 in the LAST and THIS columns and a slashed zero in the CUMULATIVE column. The cumulative 0 is the internally consistent reading IF the 2943.41 self-contribution on Form A is counted as money in (2943.41 in - 2943.41 out = 0); the line-1 zeros are the inconsistency. All cells retained verbatim, nothing recomputed. No earlier filing by this filer in this cycle is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available.

escalation_note: p3 amount column strip at 1200 dpi + control; p2 amount cell at 1200 dpi + control. The p3 escalation reversed row 1's cents from 83 to 82, confirmed by the schedule closing to the cover exactly.
